basics.name: Risto Kallas
basics.label: Senior Software Developer
basics.summary:
Risto is an experienced software developer with multiple technologies and domains under his belt. He enjoys working with projects that impact the everyday life of users and uses his experience to combine beautiful, accessible applications into robust, reliable and secure services. Risto ensures that the technical solutions always are impactful and meaningful.

Be it client or server development, Risto will find the right tool for the job. Risto also likes to help his team to improve and enjoys finding solutions to both technical and ways-of-working problems.

Risto believes that AI is a very useful assistant but not a replacement for experienced developers.
basics.x-tagline: Building high-quality software that makes people's daily lives a little easier — and turning business needs into technical opportunities that really matter.

x-strengths.title: Mobile application development
x-strengths.description: Risto has worked with both native development with Java and Kotlin and cross-platform technologies like React Native. He has worked on projects with high security and accessibility (WCAG 2.2) requirements, and working with mobile solutions is his main strength.

x-strengths.title: Server & web development
x-strengths.description: Risto has worked with Java backend services mainly utilizing Spring and has worked with web frameworks like React and Angular.

x-keyRoles.title: Mobile development
x-keyRoles.description: Risto has worked with native Android development using Java and Kotlin and with cross-platform technologies like React Native. He is also interested in Flutter to see where the scene goes with it.

x-keyRoles.title: Full-stack development
x-keyRoles.description: While not in the latest projects, Risto has worked on full-stack projects with Java and AngularJS / React.

projects.name: Large-scale finance and loyalty Android application
projects.x-note: The highlight slide ('Senior Software Developer', 2021 - present) covers this project and the preceding one for the same client via the mobile consultancy; it is merged here.
projects.description:
Working on one of the most used finance / commerce applications in Finland. The project has high security and accessibility requirements, as users do their daily banking activities and other loyalty program related tasks with it. Risto's tasks included working on the Android client and related backend services, and he also helps improve the ways-of-working of the team.

Responsible for developing and specifying features for the large-scale Android application and developing features and integrations for Java/Spring backend services.

projects.name: Large-scale Android application
projects.description: Responsible for developing and specifying features for a large-scale Android application. Acted as a substitute team lead at one point for a month.

projects.name: Consumer postal services Android app
projects.description:
A consumer postal services app is the client's consumer application for its services and an integral part of modern Finnish postal services. Risto's role was Android developer, where he played a key role in the architectural decisions on the application implementation.

Responsible for developing, specifying and architecting the Android application. Was also part of creating a custom native-to-web solution where a web application could be bundled with a native application.

projects.name: Construction documentation application
projects.x-note: Year from the highlight slide; the project list gives only the duration.
projects.description: The client's application is used to manage various construction documents, inspections and incident reports. Users fill in forms and other regulatory documents with the application to help with the bureaucracy involved in the construction industry. Risto's tasks were developing the React Native application, including camera and file storage functionality, and helping the startup to reach its market.

projects.name: Location based MVP Android app
projects.description: Responsible for developing a location based MVP Android app and assisting in server application development.

projects.name: Meeting assistant web application
projects.description: A meeting assistant web application built on the Salesforce platform. Companies can integrate it within their Salesforce cloud solution to help with various meeting related tasks; the application was used for creating meeting notes and converting them to various objects used in Salesforce CRM. Risto was responsible for full stack application development with Java and Angular and for improving the DevOps of the project.

projects.name: Workforce hiring application
projects.description: Responsible for developing an Android application and assisting in developing backend features for an application used for hiring workforce.

projects.name: Card game
projects.description: Responsible for developing features for a card game.

projects.name: Running app (a route planning app)
projects.description: Responsible for feature development for an Android application used for running.
